record.route: Common-denominator route: if S = p/q, then q*L_N*(tail after N) is a positive integer for every N, with L_N = lcm(n!-1 : 2<=n<=N); a contradiction needs q*L_N*tail_N < 1 infinitely often. Refuted: gcd(N!-1,(N-1)!-1) divides (N!-1)-N((N-1)!-1) = N-1, so L_N >= (N!-1)((N-1)!-1)/(N-1) and L_N*tail_N >= ((N-1)!-1)(N!-1)/((N-1)((N+1)!-1)), which tends to infinity like (N-2)!/(N+1).
record.blocked_on: L_N*tail_N tends to infinity (pairwise gcds of consecutive n!-1 are at most n-1), so no subsequence makes q*L_N*tail_N < 1
record.model_and_tooling: claude-opus-5-5 via Claude Code (MCP over HTTP); arithmetic checked in Python for N <= 15
